en.title: Pizza Order Closest to Budget
en.description:
Buy exactly one pizza and choose 0, 1, or 2 toppings, each topping at most once. Find the price of the order whose total is closest to the budget. If the differences tie, choose the lower price. Different indices are different topping types, even if their prices are equal.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n m x: the number of pizza types, the number of topping types, and the budget (1≤n≤10, 0≤m≤10, 1≤x≤10000). The second line contains n pizza prices; the third line contains m topping prices (it may be an empty line when m=0). All prices are 1..10000, and the total topping price does not exceed 10000.
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Enumerate each pizza with no topping, one topping, or two toppings at different indices. Compare candidates by (absolute difference, total price).
